name: Mumbai Trail Runners
tagline: Weekend trails, weekday grit — runners of every pace welcome.
about:
We are Mumbai's largest weekend trail running community. Every Saturday morning we meet at Sanjay Gandhi National Park for guided group runs ranging from 5K to 21K, suited to every fitness level. Beyond the runs, we host monthly trail maintenance days, nutrition workshops, and an annual trail marathon that draws runners from across Maharashtra.

Whether you're training for your first 10K or your tenth ultramarathon, you'll find a pace group and a support crew here.
mission: To make trail running accessible, safe, and fun for every Mumbaikar, regardless of experience level.
codeOfConduct: Respect the trails, respect each other. No littering, no headphones on group runs, and always run within your pace group.

faqs.question: Do I need trail running shoes?
faqs.answer: Recommended but not required for beginner routes.

faqs.question: Is this club free to join?

name: Bengaluru Tech Circle
tagline: Deep-dive talks and hands-on workshops for working engineers.
about:
Bengaluru Tech Circle brings together backend engineers, ML practitioners, and startup founders for monthly deep-dive talks and quarterly hands-on workshops. Past sessions have covered distributed systems, LLM fine-tuning, and scaling Postgres to a billion rows.

Membership includes access to our private Slack, a searchable talk archive, and discounted tickets to our annual TechCircle Summit.
mission: Raise the technical bar for engineering teams in Bengaluru through peer-led learning.
codeOfConduct: Be kind, no recruiting spam in the community channels, credit your sources when presenting.

faqs.question: What does membership include?
faqs.answer: Slack access, talk archive, and summit discounts.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund?
faqs.answer: Yes, within 7 days of purchase if unused.

pricingPlans.name: Annual Membership
pricingPlans.description: Full access to talks, Slack, and the summit.

name: Delhi Foodies Collective
tagline: Chasing the best street food and hidden gems across the capital.
about: Delhi Foodies Collective is a community of people obsessed with the capital's food scene — from Chandni Chowk chaat stalls to the newest fine-dining pop-ups. We organise monthly food walks, do crowd-sourced restaurant reviews, and run an annual 'Golden Paratha' awards for the city's best hole-in-the-wall eateries.

faqs.question: Are food walks free?
faqs.answer: Club membership is free; food walks may have a small per-head cost.

name: Pune Indie Gamers
tagline: LAN nights, indie game jams, and co-op squads.
about: Pune Indie Gamers hosts monthly LAN nights, seasonal 48-hour game jams, and matchmaking for co-op squads across Valorant, Apex, and indie multiplayer titles. We also showcase member-built indie games at our quarterly Demo Day.

faqs.question: Do I need my own PC?
faqs.answer: Yes, LAN nights are BYOD (bring your own device).

name: Chennai Classical Music Circle
tagline: Carnatic music appreciation, lec-dems, and the December season.
about: A community for Carnatic music lovers in Chennai. We organise lecture-demonstrations with visiting artists, curate group outings during the December music season, and maintain a members-only recording archive of live concerts going back a decade.

faqs.question: Is prior music knowledge required?
faqs.answer: No, all appreciation levels are welcome.

pricingPlans.name: Season Pass
pricingPlans.description: Access to the recording archive and season outings.

name: Hyderabad Photography Club
tagline: Street, portrait, and astrophotography walks every month.
about: Hyderabad Photography Club runs themed photo walks every month — Old City street photography, Golconda astrophotography nights, and portrait sessions with amateur models. Members get feedback on their shots in weekly critique threads.

name: Jaipur Heritage Walks
tagline: Rediscovering the Pink City, one alley at a time.
about: We lead early-morning heritage walks through Jaipur's old city, uncovering stories behind its havelis, step-wells, and bazaars with local historians. New routes are added every season.

name: Kochi Books & Brews
tagline: One book a month, one coffee shop at a time.
about: A cosy, members-only book club that meets on the first Sunday of every month at a rotating Kochi coffee shop. We alternate between fiction and non-fiction picks, voted on by members.

faqs.question: How do I join a private club?
faqs.answer: Requests are approved manually by the club owner.

name: Goa Beach Yoga Collective
tagline: Sunrise yoga on the sand, every single day.
about: Daily sunrise yoga sessions on Ashwem beach, led by certified instructors. Monthly membership includes unlimited daily classes, a welcome kit, and discounted retreat weekends.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, all levels are welcome with modifications offered.

name: Chandigarh Startup Founders
tagline: Founders supporting founders in the tricity region.
about: A private, invite-only network for early-stage startup founders in the Chandigarh tricity region to share fundraising advice, swap intros, and run peer mastermind sessions.

pricingPlans.name: Founding Member
pricingPlans.description: Access to mastermind sessions and founder directory.
